informes.tpl.corrida.desc: What happened in a run: species, events, genetics and the six metric groups.
informes.tpl.comparacion.desc: Two runs overlaid, with their configuration differences and their final values.
informes.tpl.replicas.desc: Mean, p10–p90 band and a table of means and deviations from a replicates job.
informes.faltanCorridas: Comparing needs two runs: save the current one or run another.
informes.mismaCorrida: A and B are the same run: the report will show two identical curves.
informes.sinTrabajos: There are no finished replicates jobs yet.
informes.sinTrabajosEnCola.uno: There is {n} replicates job in the queue; the report can be generated when it finishes.
informes.sinTrabajosEnCola.otros: There are {n} replicates jobs in the queue; the report can be generated when they finish.
informes.resumenNota: The summary is built by rules from the data (dominance, collapse, extinction and DNA growth); each sentence links to its figure and, if a detector finds nothing, it writes nothing.
informes.vistaVacia: Pick a template and generate the report to see it here.
informes.vistaNota: A single .html file with the charts and the data inside: it opens offline and prints to PDF from the browser.
informes.ninguno: You have not generated any report yet.
informes.error.sinCorrida: the run is no longer available
informes.error.sinTrabajo: the replicates job is no longer in the queue
informes.error.ventana: The browser did not allow the print window: allow pop-ups for this site, or download the .html and print it from there.
informes.error.inexistente: That report is no longer saved.
informes.error.almacen: Could not read or delete the saved report: {detalle}
informes.sinCorridas: There is no current run and no saved runs: run or load one in Observe.
informes.datos.sinCorrida: There is no run to analyze: the data and the PNG come from the run Analyze is showing.
informes.png.leyendaCortada: The PNG legend shows {max} of the {n} series.
informes.error.cod.faltan-corridas: the data of the two runs is missing
informes.error.cod.faltan-replicas: the job's seeds or results are missing
informes.error.cod.png-svg: the browser could not draw the chart as an image
informes.error.cod.png-imagen: the browser did not create the image (try a smaller chart)
informes.error.cod.falta-torneo: the tournament or its matches are missing
informes.error.cod.falta-barrido: the sweep's values, seeds or results are missing
